products.name: Browse AI
products.note: Web scraping automation; data extraction; monitoring; terms-of-service compliance risk

profile_text.body:
Browse AI is a no-code web scraping and monitoring platform founded in 2020. The company describes itself as a tool that lets users scrape data from websites, monitor pages for changes, and turn websites into APIs or live datasets without writing any code. Its platform includes features such as dynamic content capture, built-in bot evasion, proxy management, automatic retries, and rate limiting, and it markets itself to a broad range of users from beginners to teams with more complex data workflows.

The core AI product, also called Browse AI, uses AI-powered extraction to structure scraped data automatically and to detect when a target website has changed, adapting its scraping robots accordingly so that data pipelines do not break. Users can connect extracted data to external workflows or databases through REST API integrations. The site offers pre-built scraping robots for specific sites and use cases, including product and pricing data from Best Buy and AI tool listings from directories such as Futurepedia and Future Tools.

The held facts note that the Browse AI product carries a terms-of-service compliance risk, reflecting the well-documented legal and contractual uncertainty around automated web scraping. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the available data.
